title: Consecutive Available Seats
goal: List free seats that belong to a consecutive available group of at least two.
strategy: A free seat qualifies exactly when the seat immediately before or after it is also free. Looking up numeric neighbors avoids confusing adjacent input rows with adjacent seat numbers.
